name: Hushed Bank
summary: At Hushed Bank, Duskwood’s western river marks the way from Three Corners toward Stranglethorn Vale. Beasts stalk its quiet shore, where dark mysteries linger.

sections.title: A Frontier Along the River
sections.body: Hushed Bank follows Duskwood’s western edge beside the river that divides the forest from Westfall. A covered wooden bridge carries travelers west, out of the grim wood. Near the bridge, open plains and sunlit farms give way to unnatural twilight. Thick underbrush and creeping fog crowd the riverbanks, where large spiders and hungry forest wolves stalk anyone who strays from the path.

sections.title: Outcasts and Hermits
sections.body: Near Hushed Bank’s northern end, Sven Yorgen and his companion Lars keep camp in the dense woods, beyond Darkshire’s suspicious eyes. They watch the treeline and carry bitter grievances tied to the region’s dark tragedies. Their refuge lies far from others, one of the few signs of living humanoids along this lonely shore.

faq.q: Where is the Hushed Bank located?
faq.answer: Hushed Bank follows Duskwood’s western edge beside the river that separates the forest from Westfall. It runs from the fork near Three Corners south toward the borders leading to Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: What connects the Hushed Bank to Westfall?
aliases: how to cross river to westfall
faq.answer: A covered wooden bridge spans the river at Hushed Bank, carrying travelers and carts between Westfall and Duskwood.

faq.q: Who lives along the Hushed Bank?
faq.answer: Sven Yorgen and his companion Lars keep camp in northern Hushed Bank. They live as isolated recluses, having fled the horrors that claimed Sven’s nearby farm.

faq.q: What threats are found along this shoreline?
faq.answer: Large woodland beasts prowl Hushed Bank, including webwood spiders and dusking wolves that prey on anything moving through the brush.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can track the wolves and spiders haunting the dense foliage along the riverbank, familiar beasts of the forest’s darker reaches.
As an Alliance traveler, you can cross the covered bridge linking Westfall’s farmlands with Duskwood’s besieged outpost.
